main.description: List foreign records the appview indexed via the cross-family pipeline. Filter by NSID prefix, owning DID, or both. Used to discover idiolect community records, leaflet documents, margin annotations, and semble cards alongside Layers records.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response, to resume after the last returned record.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return in one page.

records.description: The page of external records returned.

uri.description: AT-URI of each returned external record.

cid.description: CID of each returned external record at this revision.

nsid.description: Collection NSID of each returned external record.

value.description: Raw record body as published by the foreign appview.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next request to fetch the following page; absent when no further records remain.
